Privacy

Commencement is an experimental browser arcade game. Gameplay, the vehicle and the campus geometry run locally in your browser. There are no accounts, location searches, API keys or session uploads. The game does not load Google Maps or Street View.

Google Fonts requests and hosted access can transmit ordinary network information to their providers. System fonts are used when the font request fails.

Sources and references are documented in Credits. Virtual driving does not represent real road conditions.
